name: Combined Immunodeficiency due to ORAI1 Deficiency

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the ORAI1 gene
Demonstration of defective calcium release-activated calcium (CRAC) channel function in lymphocytes
Presence of severe combined immunodeficiency phenotype with recurrent infections and impaired T-cell function
Reduced T-cell proliferation response to mitogens and antigens
Normal or near-normal lymphocyte counts despite functional impairment

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Biallelic pathogenic ORAI1 variants plus clinical combined immunodeficiency phenotype with impaired CRAC channel function
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Functional assays of calcium influx are critical to confirm diagnosis alongside genetic testing.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe recurrent bacterial and viral infections
searchTerms: frequent serious bacterial and viral infections
repeated infections from bacteria and viruses

pathognomonic.symptomName: Impaired T-cell activation due to defective calcium influx
searchTerms: T cells not activating due to calcium problem
immune cells with faulty calcium signaling
poor T-cell activation from calcium defects

common.symptomName: Chronic diarrhea due to gastrointestinal infections

searchTerms: failure to gain weight as baby

laboratory: Absent or severely reduced calcium influx in T lymphocytes upon activation
Normal lymphocyte counts with impaired proliferative responses
Elevated serum IgM with low IgG and IgA levels
imaging: Chest X-ray may show absent or hypoplastic thymus
other: Flow cytometry demonstrating defective CRAC channel function

distinguishingFeatures: SCID typically presents with lymphopenia, whereas ORAI1 deficiency may have normal lymphocyte counts
SCID caused by other gene defects lacks CRAC channel dysfunction
Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome presents with thrombocytopenia and eczema
ORAI1 deficiency has characteristic calcium influx defect

redFlags: Severe recurrent infections in early infancy
Failure to thrive despite adequate nutrition
Non-responsive or atypical infections despite standard treatment
references: Feske S. ORAI1 and STIM1 deficiency in human and mice: roles of CRAC channels in immunity and beyond. Immunol Rev. 2009 Nov;231(1):189-209.
Picard C, et al. STIM1 mutation associated with a syndrome of immunodeficiency and autoimmunity. N Engl J Med. 2009 Sep 3;361(10): 1035-44.
Lacruz RS, Feske S. Diseases caused by mutations in ORAI1 and STIM1. Ann N Y Acad Sci. 2015 Apr;1356:45-79.
